package.name: zed_custom_tuning
package.description:
Workspace-owned parameter overrides for the ZED 2i wrapper, kept out of the zed-ros2-wrapper submodule so `git submodule update` cannot revert them. Unlike the Hokuyo, the ZED wrapper DOES support an override file (ros_params_override_path), so this package only has to supply the YAML -- it does not need to own the launch file the way custom_config does.
Holds every deliberate departure from Stereolabs' shipped defaults, present and future, with the reason recorded beside each one. Sits in camera/ beside the submodule and custom_covariance; nothing here is vendor content.
